shared_or_similar_visual_information: A short circular arc drawn between rays near their common vertex.
mathematical_meanings: Left image: It identifies the selected angle labeled 1 at that polygon vertex. Right image: It identifies the angle between the low sloping side and the bottom horizontal ray.
Rationales: Each short arc is placed inside the wedge it selects. This use attaches an angle label to the relevant rays or identifies the marked vertex angle.
